results.evidence: InviteRow: `className={`error-on-blur${!invitesToSend[index]?.isValid || rowError ? ' errored' : ''}`}` with `rowError = inviteRowErrors[index]`; inviteRowErrors returns EXISTING_MEMBER_ROW_ERROR when `memberEmails.has(email)`. Depends on members being loaded (see c5).
inviteRowErrors: `if (ownEmail && email === ownEmail) { return SELF_INVITE_ROW_ERROR }`, using user from userLogic; row gets the errored class.

Only canSubmit gains `!firstInviteRowError`. No UI change passes a disabledReason (about removing existing members) to the submit button, and the onboarding step and per-row send button are untouched in the patch. firstInviteRowError is defined but no consumer is shown.
`const email = target_email.trim().toLowerCase()` compared against `member.user.email.toLowerCase()` in a Set.

The patch adds no explicit loadMembers on modal open; it only connects `members` from membersLogic. Whether that selector lazily loads is not visible. The own-email check does work without member data (`(members ?? [])`, user check independent).

The existing-member check moved from create() to validate_target_email (`validate_invite_target_email_is_invitable`), which runs during serializer validation before any row is saved, so no invites from the batch are created or emailed.

`raise exceptions.ValidationError("A user with this email address already belongs to the organization.", code=EXISTING_ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_CODE)` raised inside validate_target_email, so it is a field-level error on target_email with code 'existing_organization_member'.

shouldReportApiFailure: `if (status === 400 && failure.code != null && HANDLED_VALIDATION_CODES.has(failure.code)) { return false }`; other statuses and codes still fall through to `return !isApprovalRequiredError(failure)` / true.
No listener in inviteLogic reacts to inviteTeamMembersFailure to reload members; listeners only handle inviteTeamMembersSuccess and addProjectAccess.
